channel.title: Wire — Frontend
channel.description: Frontend from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Shopify Upgrades Checkout Blocks to Polaris Web Components, Cutting Bundle Sizes up to 85%
item.description: Shopify has updated its Checkout Blocks app, transitioning five high-traffic checkout UI extensions to remote-dom using Preact and Polaris web components. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Understanding Bidirectional Text: A Guide for Developers
item.description: Discover the complexities of bidirectional text, its challenges, and how to properly render languages like Arabic and Persian in the digital world. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Implementing children-count() in Modern CSS
item.description: Using Scroll-Driven Animations to count the number of children (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: How Do Passkeys Work?
item.description: Watch how passkeys work in plain language: create one, sign in on your next visit, and see why fake websites cannot use it. Explore the details when you’re curious. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Shaders: 190+ WebGPU Effect Components, Now Open Source
item.description: The Shaders rendering engine, every shader component, and the framework bindings are now MIT licensed on GitHub. Code export in the design editor is free for everyone. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: visually striking collection
item.description: Browse all 199 Shaders components: WebGPU textures, shapes, materials, filters, distortions, transitions and more for Vue, React, Svelte, Solid and JavaScript. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Video.js 10: Five Players Rebuilt as One
item.description: Video.js 10.0.0 is stable: a ground-up rebuild bringing together Video.js, Plyr, Vidstack, Media Chrome, and Mux Player, now with a redesigned install flow, Shadcn skin support, and an official skill for coding agents. (1 source: frontendfocus)
